name: All Men Are Equal
activation: Upon completion of an entrance exam
description: All Men Are Equal is the ability of Yukichi Fukuzawa. It is an inhibition ability that allows Fukuzawa to suppress the abilities of his subordinates, particularly official members of the Armed Detective Agency. This means that applicants must pass their entrance exam specifically catered and prepared for them in secret, which is the standard application procedure of the Agency to measure their values and character. Otherwise, they would not be included in the range of the ability.

name: Thou Shalt Not Die
description: Thou Shalt Not Die is the ability of Akiko Yosano. It allows Yosano to heal all kinds of physical external injuries or any kind for herself and others with the one condition that they must have near fatal injuries. Therefore, in order for her ability to be used, the target must be injured enough to be half-dead. Thou Shalt Not Die is often used as a means to heal the injuries of the Armed Detective Agency after combat, from which stems their maxim that receiving fatal injuries to the point of being barely alive is synonymous to having no injuries. One exception is Osamu Dazai, since No Longer Human actively nullifies any ability including Yosano's healing. This requires him to undergo standard medical procedure, such as surgery, to recover from external wounds that he receives.

name: Beast Beneath the Moonlight
description: Beast Beneath the Moonlight is the ability of Atsushi Nakajima and his BEAST counterpart. It gives Atsushi the ability to transform into a white tiger. At first, he did not seem to have much control over the transformation, likely due to the fact or caused by his unawareness of his state as an ability user. After becoming an official member of the Armed Detective Agency and under the influence of All Men Are Equal, he gains more control over his transformations.

name: The Matchless Poet
description: The Matchless Poet is the ability of Doppo Kunikida. The ability allows Kunikida to materialize objects by writing them in his notebook, ripping out the page, and willing them into existence. However, he cannot produce objects larger than his notebook. He can also produce a replica of an object just by getting a good look of it and understanding its mechanism and the way it works.

name: Light Snow
description: Light Snow is the ability of Jun'ichirō Tanizaki. It allows Tanizaki to create illusions within the range of a projected screen of snowfall, typically to conceal himself and other intended targets. His body can be overwritten within the scenery near him, which prevents others to see or locate him; he can later emerge out of his screen at will and unscathed from prior attacks, if any, in most cases. Moreover, Tanizaki can extend the use of his ability to camouflage other equipment, such as cameras to render him invisible from the footage and a small helicopter for reconnaissance missions.

name: Undefeated by the Rain
description: Undefeated by the Rain is the ability of Kenji Miyazawa. It grants Kenji superhuman strength. This allows him to lift and overturn cars (including an entire tank) with relative ease and pull street signs out of cement. He can also dismantle a rail pole from a train track with his bare hands and rip from the wall a steel door that is similarly used in high-security bank safes. The ability also appears to grant him superhuman durability, as he can withstand a direct blow to the head with no apparent damage and a barrage of bullets without getting severely harmed.

name: Demon Snow
description: Demon Snow is the ability of Kyōka Izumi passed on to her by her mother. Demon Snow allows its wielder to materialize a female sword-wielding phantom known as Demon Snow, infamously deemed as the incarnation of slaughter. In Kyōka's case, it initially followed orders coming from a mobile phone she always carries on her person, which was given to her by her mother. After she joins the Armed Detective Agency, this restriction was subverted with Yukichi Fukuzawa's ability, which enables Kyōka to control her own ability and use it normally without having to rely on her phone as medium.

name: No Longer Human
description: No Longer Human is the ability of Osamu Dazai. It nullifies the ability of anyone Dazai touches. Furthermore, the ability relies on skin contact and is always active. As such, he can nullify any ability even while restrained as soon and as long as it touches him. Due to this specific condition, the ability also apparently nullifies Akiko Yosano's healing ability.

name: Super Deduction
activation: Putting on a pair of glasses given to him by Yukichi Fukuzawa.
description: Super Deduction is the appellation for Ranpo Edogawa's deduction prowess. It allows Ranpo to deduce and extract the 'truth' behind any crime by giving him every information about it. As such, this skill is invaluable and highly unmatched in solving crime scenes, allowing him to figure out where to find evidence and who the culprit is within a matter of seconds. Eventually, he came to recognize that he does not possess any supernatural ability.

name: Futon
description: Futon is the ability of Katai Tayama. It enables Katai to manipulate electrical signals which he can use to manipulate any electronics within his sight. Moreover, his ability allows him to process information dozens of times faster than an average human and can be considered to even rival the military's information warfare units. Additionally, Katai can only seemingly concentrate on using his ability with optimal efficiency wherever his body and mind are most relaxed, which Doppo Kunikida mentioned to be when he is wrapped in his futon named Yoshiko. Katai can also remotely control communication lines at quick speeds with his ability.

name: Vita Sexualis
description: Vita Sexualis is the ability of Ōgai Mori. Elise is its manifestation. Vita Sexualis allows Mori to summon and configure Elise's personality in any way he wills. As such, he can make her levitate, chase after an enemy at high speed, and make her save him from imminent peril by manipulating Elise as his ability. Moreover, he can notably summon Elise having a medical semblance and make her attack his opponents with a barrage of large medical equipment.

name: The Madness of the Jewel King
description: The Madness of the Jewel King is the ability of Ace. It allows Ace to change the lifespans of his subordinates into jewels of a similar value. In particular, he provides his men with a special collar with a jewel in it, which cannot be equipped without their own discretion. Upon wearing it on the neck, the collar cannot ever be taken off again. When Ace activates his ability on his target, the jewel on the person's collar illuminates as they eventually die. Afterwards, jewels of a proportionate 'value' to the victim's lifespan will materialize on his palm.

name: Matter-Manipulation Ability
activation: Raise his arm and squeezed his hand into a fist
description: This matter-manipulation ability is the unnamed ability of the Colonel. He could liquefy mass and manipulate it. For instance, he could bend the ground beneath him and control it to his own will, as well as liquefy ground, trees, and a collapsed train to attack an airborne target. However, the ability did not work on things out of the Colonel's sight.

name: Upon the Tainted Sorrow
japaneseName: 汚れっちまった悲しみに
description: Upon the Tainted Sorrow is the ability of Chūya Nakahara. It allows Chūya to manipulate the gravity of any object or individual he gets in contact with. As such, he can change the direction and force of gravity from its standard downward 1G force, as long as the matter is touched somewhere with his body. Chūya typically uses his ability for offensive purposes. He can manipulate physical matter from the surrounding area, such as the ground he is in, to use as his weapon and launch at his opponents, crushing them with the force-enhanced matter. Corruption (汚濁) is the true form of Chūya's ability and is exceedingly dangerous. This ability allows him to manipulate the gravitons in his surroundings. By increasing his own density, he is capable of crushing a tank with his bare hands. He is also able to shoot balls of compressed gravity that act like black holes that swallow anything. However, he has no control over his Ability's true form; he will continue in that state if his Ability is not nullified until he dies. It is activated by the verse: 'O acquaintances, grantors of dark disgrace, do not wake me again'.

name: Golden Demon
description: Golden Demon is the ability of Kōyō Ozaki. It allows Kōyō to summon a female sword-wielding phantom, which is quite similar to Kyōka Izumi's ability. However, unlike Kyōka who needed to initially activate and control her ability through an intermediary phone, Kōyō can manipulate her ability freely, and she control its activation and dissipation at will. Like Demon Snow, Golden Demon has a high offensive power and force capable of inflicting wounds through its katana with high speed and accuracy.

name: Gravity-Manipulation Ability
description: This gravitation-manipulation ability is the unnamed ability of Paul Verlaine. Similar with Chūya Nakahara's ability, Verlaine can manipulate the gravity vector and magnitude of anything and anyone he gets in contact with. He can enhance gravity to crush and incapacitate targets in place, which Chūya—a gravity-manipulation ability user himself—cannot break away from to a fault. Verlaine can increase his own body's density to land dense attacks on his opponents with his punches and kicks. He can snap his opponents' necks with ease using gravity, which killed Murase and almost N.

name: Illuminations
description: Illuminations is the ability of Arthur Rimbaud and Paul Verlaine. It allows Rimbaud to create a hyperspace, which is a completely isolated sphere outside the normal space, that he has full control over and that has different dimensions from the physical world. Initially, the ability had been shown to take the form of small, cubic hyperspaces that can restrain individuals, among other purposes. Aside from such forms, Rimbaud can alter his hyperspace's ranges accordingly, capable of generating a hyperspace massive enough to cover an entire shipyard greater than its roof. Illuminations can also turn people into abilities, even capable of resurrection to an extent. Specifically, Rimbaud can bring living humans or corpses to his hyperspaces and turn them into ability users. However, only one corpse can be brought back to life at a time and used as his ability. Because it does not adhere to the laws of physics, Illuminations proves to be a natural weakness against Chūya's Upon the Tainted Sorrow, which is heavily reliant on the laws of gravity to function.

name: Rashōmon
description: Rashōmon is the ability of Ryūnosuke Akutagawa. It enables Akutagawa to freely manipulate the shape and properties of his clothing. Akutagawa usually transforms his black coat into sharp blades that can easily slash off limbs or into a dragon-like beast which is said to consume anything, even space itself. This allows Akutagawa to create an impenetrable shield that can block incoming attacks, such as gunfire and punches, since the space that they would normally have to cross to reach Akutagawa has been consumed. Rashōmon can also be used to increase Akutagawa's mobility, such as elevating himself into the air or using his coat like a grappling hook to propel himself to otherwise unreachable locations. It is also capable of digging and slicing the ground.

name: Falling Camellia
description: Falling Camellia is the ability of Ryūrō Hirotsu. When activated, Falling Camellia generates strong repulsion on things he touches with his palm. It has been shown that his ability is powerful enough to stop and bend steel pipes, break doors open, and even cleave swords with a single touch. When used on a human body, besides launching it, the ability can also cause the bones of the target to break and get deformed.

name: Midwinter Memento
description: Midwinter Memento is the ability of Michizō Tachihara. It grants Tachihara ferrokinesis or the ability to manipulate metal, which Teruko Okura once mentioned to be well-suited for stealing, altering information, and assassination. This makes him ideal for espionage and stealth operations, as his ability ranges from meticulously breaking through a safe to partially stopping an incoming enemy aircraft.

name: Dogra Magra
description: Dogra Magra is the ability of Kyūsaku Yumeno. It is a mind control ability, described by Osamu Dazai to be the anathema of all abilities and the ultimate reason why Q was sealed in confinement by the Port Mafia. To activate their ability, a target or 'receiver' hurts Q through several means. A handprint blotch appears on the receiver's body to signal they have been cursed. Q then mutilates their doll, and the receiver is ravaged by sinister illusions, which makes the target attack everyone within proximity in a blind rampage.

name: Lemonade
description: Lemonade is the ability of Motojirō Kajii. It Kajii from being harmed, injured, and affected by lemon-shaped bombs, which he makes himself. This allows him to survive any explosion caused by his lemon bombs regardless of his distance from the blast. Because of his apparently absolute defense from his lemon bomb explosions, Kajii typically uses this to his advantage in attacking bases and enemies, capable of sinking an entire ship.

name: Flawless
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: Flawless is the ability of Sakunosuke Oda. It allowed Oda to see a few seconds of the future in his mind, similar to the ability of André Gide. Specifically, the length of each future vision was longer than five seconds but no more than six seconds. As a result, the ability could render most surprise attacks useless, such as a sniper attack, an explosion, and various other movements that he could dodge immediately. Moreover, the future that Oda could see with this ability was limited to his current decision. If he decided to change his actions based on a future vision, he would see another future play out. In this case, it might be a future that would bring another danger that he was unable to see in his vision, and it might be too late to avoid it at that point.

name: Hail in the Begging Bowl
description: Hail in the Begging Bowl is the ability of Santōka Taneda. It allows Taneda to see through the nature of someone's ability immediately if activated near him. For instance, he was able to understand how the information exchange ability of Sigma works upon meeting up with him during the hostage incident orchestrated by the Decay of the Angel. Moreover, as stated by Ango Sakaguchi, Taneda's ability helped the Special Division for Unusual Powers bury countless of malevolent and hostile ability users.

name: Discourse on Decadence
description: Discourse on Decadence is the ability of Ango Sakaguchi. It is an extraction ability that allows Ango to read the memories left on materials that he touches. For example, Ango used this ability to read into the escape route of Mushitaro Oguri along with Atsushi Nakajima and Kyōka Izumi by using his ability on the ground they passed through and later on some of Mushitaro's stolen cash money while escaping. This ability may also work on humans as seen when Ango offered to read the information sent by Sigma towards Atsushi in order to figure out Kamui's location.

name: Yesterday's Shadow Tag
description: Yesterday's Shadow Tag is the ability of Mizuki Tsujimura. Tsujimura's ability is transferred to her by mother. It allows her to create 'baby shadows' and control their strange/curious lives. It most often acts as an automatic response type ability that follows the command placed on it by her mother: 'Kill anyone who my daughter Mizuki Tsujimura tries to kill right before she kills them.' In other words, Tsujimura's ability will activate immediately when she wants to kill someone and the body shadow will slaughter them faster than she can kill them. Thus, making Tusijmura unable to kill anyone herself. Tsujimura has no control over this function of her ability.

name: The Great Fitzgerald
japaneseName: 華麗なるフィッツジェラルド
description: The Great Fitzgerald is the ability of Francis Scott Key Fitzgerald. It grants a boost to Fitzgerald's physical prowess that is directly proportional to the amount of money he spends. This allows him to have greater strength, speed, agility, and endurance beyond the normal human level. Notably, Fitzgerald throws off his cheques and states the amount of money he spends to activate his ability, though he can still 'spend' some money for his ability by merely verbalizing his spent money. Moreover, distinguishing green markings appear throughout Fitzgerald's skin and garments, which signal that his ability is activated. Activation of the ability is not restricted to Fitzgerald's own wealth, as he can use others' wealth, provided they 'offer' it to him for his ability.

name: Black Cat in the Rue Morgue
description: Black Cat in the Rue Morgue is the ability of Edgar Allan Poe. It allows Poe to transport readers into the setting of any novel, though it must be one they are currently reading. People transported to the novel's setting can only return to the real world when they solve the mystery they are trapped in. The ability works regardless of any reading medium, such as a book or a phone.

name: Moby Dick
description: Moby Dick is the ability of Herman Melville. It is also formerly one of The Guild's bases. Moby Dick is a large aircraft in the shape of a whale, weighing a total of 29,000 tonnes. Herman mentions that Moby Dick is, in fact, a living being which once freely roamed in the sky. However, the Guild eventually turned it into an air fortress, with more than 70% of it modified. Because of this, he no longer had control of the whale.

name: Great Old One
japaneseName: ハワード・フィリップス・ラヴクラフト
description: Great Old One is a non-ability that activates Howard Phillips Lovecraft's eldritch form. It allows Lovecraft to transform either a part or his whole body into an eldritch monster with tentacles. As such, he can contort his body parts, and his eyes notably become wider and almost blank. He can also sprout numerous tentacles dotted with suction cups and holes along their surface at random intervals, is undefined in length, and anywhere from his body. Lovecraft's true form appears as a massive, tentacled entity with wings and a pair of glowing, seeming eyes. In this state, he is only vulnerable from the inside. Since this power is not an ability, Osamu Dazai is unable to nullify it.

name: The Grapes of Wrath
description: The Grapes of Wrath is the ability of John Steinbeck. It allows Steinbeck to grow grapevines from any part of his body by planting a seed onto such part. By grafting the vines attached to his body to other plants, the flora in the entire vicinity can also become an extension of his body, allowing him to sense his targets nearby such extensions. His own branches and those from the flora can also be used as a means for capturing and holding a target with tremendous strength and to shield himself from enemy attacks. The grapevines can tightly restrain targets in place, such as people, objects, and even manifestations of abilities. The ability can also be used for monitoring and stealth purposes.

name: Anne of Abyssal Red
description: Anne of Abyssal Red is the ability of Lucy Maud Montgomery. It allows Lucy to create an alternate space known as Anne's Room upon activation within close to medium proximity, where Lucy's targets are transported to. The eponymous Anne is a giant doll-like creature with immense strength and speed, who is shown to chase targets mainly to capture them inside the chamber while playing hide-and-seek or tag. While inside this space, no attacks can penetrate nor affect Anne. The room contains an exit door, which can lead the targets brought to the dimension back to the real world. Apparently, leaving Anne's Room through the exit door will make the person's memories regarding everything that transpired inside vanish.

name: Little Women
description: Little Women is the ability of Louisa May Alcott. It is a time-based ability that enables Louisa to make time pass at 1/8000th of regular speed, though only when she is alone in a private room. For instance, three minutes in real time can be relatively equivalent to just over two weeks' worth of preparation and strategizing time for Louisa when she uses her ability.

name: Gone With the Wind
description: Gone With the Wind is the ability of Margaret Mitchell. It is a weathering ability that allows Margaret to break down materials with the wind upon activation. Little is known on what kind of materials are restricted, but it has been shown that Mitchell is able to separate pages of a book from its gutter and even disintegrate garments quite specifically.

name: Huck Finn and Tom Sawyer
japaneseName: ハック・フィン&トム・ソーヤ
description: Huck Finn and Tom Sawyer is the ability of Mark Twain. The sniper-based ability takes the forms of the doll-like creatures known as Huck Finn and Tom Sawyer. With this twofold ability, Twain can shoot with absolute accuracy by attaching either Huck or Tom to one of his bullets to pinpoint a target's precise location, then to attack them afterwards. Since Huck's and Tom's minds are also linked, Twain can perform long-distance surveillance using them.

name: The Scarlet Letter
description: The Scarlet Letter is the ability of Nathaniel Hawthorne. It allows Hawthorne to convert his own blood into holy words and control them, which he considers as the Word of God meant to aid him in administering punishment to the unjust. It can be used for offense through converting Hawthorne's blood into bullets of varying calibers and intensities. He can also form a shield using the ability to deflect an opponent's attack.

name: A Feast in Time of Plague
description: A Feast in Time of Plague is the ability of Alexander Pushkin. It is a virus-type ability that is usually infected and activated to two target hosts. The virus is transmitted through open wounds, which causes the infected individuals with high fever and dizziness. In 48 hours, their bodies' microfauna grow and simultaneously eat away their internal organs. If either host dies within the given time, the virus ability will cease to activate. Hence, the most common method to deactivate the virus on one host is to kill the other host within 48 hours.

name: The Precipice
description: The Precipice is the ability of Ivan Goncharov. It lets Goncharov control the earth element, allowing him to manipulate rocks into golem-like arms or utilizing them as floating, omni-directional defense and offense, one way of which is by spinning rocks at high speeds. Hence, this enables him to cover his bases regardless whence his enemy strikes. His connection with the earth allows his constant awareness of enemies in his surroundings as long as they are standing on the ground.

name: The Perfect Crime
description: The Perfect Crime is the ability of Mushitarō Oguri. It is a reality-altering ability that allows Mushitarō to perfectly erase any evidence of a crime. Upon activation, the ability takes the form of small, invisible creatures oozing out of his body to tamper and 'erase' any potential evidence to a certain crime. Though it can alter realities, it cannot change or affect people's memories in a crime scene. For example, when a person sees a particular crime unfold personally, the ability cannot erase such kind of evidence in the memory of the witness.

name: And Then There Were None
japaneseName: そして誰もいなくなった
description: And Then There Were None is the ability of Dame Agatha Christie. The current details of this ability are currently not known.

name: Mirror Lion
description: Mirror Lion is the Ability of Ōchi Fukuchi. It allows Fukuchi to enhance and increase the efficiency of any weapon he holds by a hundredfold. This includes any form of material within his reach, including his Hunting Dogs katana, a ship's handrail, someone's fist, and even a stone.

name: Draculea
description: Draculea was Bram Stoker's ability. It was an infection-type ability that turns whoever he bites into a vampire. It also made the victim the next aggressor. Bram was able to control all the turned vampires, and each one acted like a single form of life.

name: The Overcoat
description: The Overcoat is the ability of Nikolai Gogol. It is a transfer-type ability that allows Gogol to use his cloak to manipulate spaces and what comes out of them. Specifically, his cloak is connected to a pocket dimension within a vertical range of 30 meters through which can allow him to manifest or transfer various materials and matter. The ability works on living things as well, as he recurrently uses it to manifest his hand through his cloak.

name: Information Exchange Ability
description: This information exchange ability is the ability of Sigma. Upon contact with another person, the ability allows Sigma to exchange the information he wishes to know most with the information the other person wishes to know most. As a side effect, the person that Sigma exchanges information with may experience momentary loss of consciousness as a result of a possible information influx.

name: Gasp of the Soul
description: Gasp of the Soul is the ability of Teruko Ōkura. It allows Teruko to manipulate the age of anyone she touches. Teruko herself mainly uses her ability for interrogation and torture, with the ability allowing her to rapidly age someone to old age and cause them to develop several illnesses and maladies normal to old people before rapidly pulling them back to a much younger age. Moreover, Teruko can use her ability on herself, allowing her to alter her physical age for both disguising herself and to mature her body to a more physically stronger age.

name: Priceless Tears
description: Priceless Tears is the ability of Saigiku Jōno. It allows Jōno to manipulate and disintegrate his own body into particles that are about 20 micrometers, that lets him slip through small spaces such as air conditioners and gaps of doors to avoid attacks. Moreover, he can atomize parts of his body, such as when avoiding a sword slice to his face. This cluster of particles is said to appear like an afterglow that cannot be affected by guns or swords.

name: Plum Blossoms in Snow
description: Plum Blossoms in Snow is the ability of Tetchō Suehiro. It allows Tetchō to extend his saber for long distances and bend it at will, which makes it difficult - if not impossible - to outrun its length and span. In addition, it can cleave an entire vehicle into two from a far distance and even penetrate the walls of a helicopter flying at a high altitude from the ground.
